title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam Okuayinonu (ankle) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: 49ers DL Sam Okuayinonu returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Okuayinonu left practice early on Wednesday due to an ankle injury. He was back on the field on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Osa Odighizuwa returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: 49ers DE Osa Odighizuwa returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Odighizuwa sat out practice on Wednesday due to soreness. He was back on the field on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dre Greenlaw returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: 49ers LB Dre Greenlaw returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Greenlaw sat out practice on Wednesday due to soreness. He was back on the field on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: John Franklin-Myers dealing with back injury
items.desc: John Franklin-Myers back stiffness flared up in practice earlier this week.
items.impact: Franklin-Myers is day-to-day in Titans training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colton Dowell waived by the 49ers
items.impact: Dowell will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kion Smith signs with 49ers
items.impact: Smith spent last season with the Dolphins. He'll compete for a depth role on the 49ers offensive line.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Demetrius Flannigan-Fowles placed on IR
items.desc: The Bills placed LB Demetrius Flannigan-Fowles on injured reserve.
items.impact: Flannigan-Fowles will likely miss the upcoming season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Kattus activated from NFI list
items.desc: The Bengals activated TE Josh Kattus from the non-football illness list.
items.impact: Kattus has been cleared to return to practice. He signed with the Bengals after going undrafted in April.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ahmari Harvey released by Steelers
items.impact: Harvey will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Israel Mukuamu signs with Steelers
items.desc: The Steelers signed CB Israel Mukuamu.
items.impact: Mukuamu spent the spring in the UFL. He will compete for a depth role in the Steelers secondary.
